_doc: Cenas dos clipes: recorte da arte docs/arte/clipe.webp (x, y, largura na arte reduzida a 1200 px; altura = largura*9/16), pedido de animação ao Wan 2.2 (scripts/kaggle/cenas.py), foco horizontal para o corte vertical e partes da música em que a cena entra (scripts/clipe.mjs).

davi.prompt: The curly haired boy strums his acoustic guitar and sings happily, bobbing his head to the music

davi-canta.prompt: Close-up: the curly haired boy sings joyfully with a big smile, moving his head to the rhythm

lulu.prompt: The fluffy white lamb bounces happily and smiles, wiggling its ears

menina.prompt: The girl in the pink dress sings and waves her arms joyfully, swaying side to side

menina-canta.prompt: Close-up: the girl with the pink bow sings happily and smiles, tilting her head

leleco.prompt: The friendly lion cub claps its paws and sways happily, smiling

duo-esquerda.prompt: The boy plays guitar while the lamb bounces next to him, both singing happily

duo-direita.prompt: The girl dances with raised arms next to the lion cub, who claps along

geral.prompt: The children and animals sing and dance together happily, slow camera push in

geral-festa.prompt: Everyone celebrates and dances, the music notes float and bounce in the air

castelo.prompt: Slow camera pan across the shining castle and the waterfall, birds flying, sunny day
